title: Medicare Telehealth Extended Through 2027
description: Medicare telehealth flexibilities, including visits from home, run through December 31, 2027. What is covered and what may change next.
intro: Medicare’s pandemic-era telehealth flexibilities have lapsed and been renewed several times. A government funding law signed in February 2026 extended them through December 31, 2027.

image.alt: Doctor talking to a patient on a video call on a laptop

cardText: Medicare telehealth flexibilities, including visits from home, run through December 31, 2027.

sections.html:
• You can generally receive Medicare telehealth services at home, wherever you live, not only in rural areas or at a clinic.
  • A wider range of practitioners can bill for telehealth.
  • Some services can be delivered audio-only when video is not possible.

Behavioral and mental health telehealth at home was already permanent under earlier law, though in-person visit requirements may apply.

• Ask whether your doctor offers video visits and how to join.
  • Check costs: normal Part B cost-sharing usually applies.
  • Medicare Advantage plans may offer additional telehealth benefits.
  • Use telehealth for follow-ups and prescription reviews; see a clinician in person when you need an exam.

Telehealth also plays a growing role in private and direct primary care.

General information, not medical, legal or insurance advice. This post reflects the position on the date shown. Check the official sources below for the latest rules.

faqs.q: Does Medicare cover telehealth at home?
faqs.a: Yes, under the flexibilities extended through December 31, 2027. Normal cost-sharing applies.
